| spellname = Translocate: Wakening Lands
| spellicon = V
| description = Opens an arcane portal that teleports your target to the [[Wakening Lands]]. The recipient of this spell must be a certain level, if they are too low level they will be evacuated to their current zone's [[Travel_Guide#Evacuate_Locations|safe spot]]. The required level is not known, but level 1 is insufficient. Unlike the equivalent Circle and Portal spells, Velious translocate spells do not require teeth like [[Tooth of the Wakening Lands]].
